modules.module_title: Introducing oneself and basic hygiene measures

pcs.pc_description: introduce oneself and provide all the relevant information necessary to begin working with patient and establish a rapport with them.
communicate in a manner that develops and maintains trust and respects cultural sensitivities and individual differences.
ensure patient's privacy using various means like screens, curtains, locking the door, etc. while assisting for any task.
promote handwashing for self and others before initiating any task
ensure hygiene and cleanliness in surroundings.
focus on safety first and ensure that the geriatric is comfortable.
use proper body mechanics and wear appropriate protective clothing while doing any task.

modules.module_title: Provide assistance while feeding, dressing up, and elimination needs

pcs.pc_description: make the geriatric comfortable and encourage eating as recommended
select appropriate clothing, food as per culture, gender, age, preferences of the patient, size, weather while dressing up the geriatric.
provide assistance for oral hygiene/mouth care, sponge bath/bed bath, care of hair lice, hair wash, back care, shaving, foot & nail care.
assist for using bed pan, urinal, uro-bag, diaper change or other elimination equipment as per instructions of health care team and health condition of geriatrics.
clean and disinfect the equipment after use
record changes and report unusual findings to health care team immediately
measure intake, output and record them

modules.module_title: Provide assistance during medication and vital assessments

pcs.pc_description: read and interpret medication order sheet for dispensing medications
follow 8R’s of medication while dispensing medication
record and report frequency, time and dosage of medicine each time as per protocol
provide support during instillation of ointment/ instillation of eye/ear drops, administration of nasal drops as per standard procedure
maintain record and report of medication error as per the protocol
assist healthcare team for vital parameters assessment
record and document the findings of vital parameters assessment
inform the authorities immediately and raise alarm in case of findings /readings deviation from normal values

modules.module_title: Support in nutritional and dietary requirements

pcs.pc_description: plan and prepare therapeutic meal for geriatrics as per health needs
use appropriate cutlery while feeding the patient, keeping in view the food temperature
ensure the food provided is according to the dietary prescription of the attending physician or dietician
assist the geriatric in the event of symptoms of distress like coughing and regurgitation while feeding and drinking and report accordingly
report the acceptability, tolerance, and consumption of meals by the client to the dietitian or relevant health professional
identify problems which may affect the client’s ability to eat or drink to the dietitian and/or other relevant health professional, according to organisation policies and procedures
report the progress of client nutritional status to the dietitian, and/or other health professional according to organisational protocols and timeframes
report dietary and nutrition issues and needs to the dietitian or healthcare provider

modules.module_title: Provide assistance in moving and positioning individuals

pcs.pc_description: use the equipment for transferring correctly to avoid falls or injuries
understand geriatric’s health condition and estimate if additional help is required
ensure safety of geriatrics at all time while moving
